notes.title: Open Beta Event
notes.content:
Greetings!

Unlike my former game releases on Steam, I will not host a closed-beta giveaway for Ten Days to War. This time the open-beta will be available for free for all.

[h1]How do I participate?[/h1]
Taking part in the open-beta is easy! Simply [url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=17AAibpAdFvsiBxbUHgraCOqBeEEI2f3-]download the latest version[/url] and start playing.

[h1]What do I do if I encounter bugs or I have a suggestion?[/h1]
Simply press the 'submit feedback' at the top right of your screen and include as much detail as possible. Once you send the feedback, I'll be sure to take a look at it and fix the issue!

[h1]Until when?[/h1]
The closed beta will end at 18th of September, just 12 days before the release date.

[h1]TIGForums Post[/h1]
Interested in reading about the game's past & its devlog? Check it out [url=https://forums.tigsource.com/index.php?topic=68382.0]here[/url]!

[h1]Don't forget to share![/h1]
If you are interested in Ten Days to War, or are likewise simply interested in helping indie developers like myself develop quality & fun games instead of rubbish ones, I ask of you to please share this with your friends! As many of them as possible!

I really do want as much feedback as possible. The more, the better.

notes.title: Release Date Delayed
notes.content:
Greetings team leaders,

The original release date of the 16th of September had to be delayed due to unforeseen development challenges in the game. Challenges such as bugs & obviously improving gameplay as a whole.

The new release date is set to the 30th of September in order to allow for more time for playtesting and fixing bugs.

- ZeroByter.
